title: A flow-cytometry-based assay to assess the cytolytic activity against tumor cells by combination of mouse MAIT cells and natural killer cells
protocol: Take day-4 to -5 OP9/DLL1 dishes from the incubator.
Replace the medium in OP9/DLL1 dishes with 9 mL of Differentiation medium stored at 4°C up to 1 month.
Prepare iPSC single cell suspension.
Count the cells and resuspend them at a concentration of 1.2 × 10^5 cells/mL in Differentiation medium.
Seed 1 mL of iPSC suspension per 10-cm OP9/DLL1 dish.
Remove all the medium on Day 3.
Add 10 mL of Differentiation medium to each dish.
Return the dishes to the CO2 incubator.
Remove the medium from the dish containing rosebud-shaped cell clusters.
Wash the dish twice with 5 mL PBS.
Spread 2 mL of 0.25% Trypsin-1 mM EDTA evenly on the dish.
Incubate the dish in a 5% CO2 incubator at 37°C for 3–5 min.
Add 8 mL of OP9 medium to the dish after confirming cells are detached.
Disrupt cell clumps by pipetting vigorously with a 1000 μL tip (about 15 times).
Place the dishes in the CO2 incubator for 45–60 min to re-adhere OP9/DLL1 cells onto the dish.
Collect floating cells using a 10-mL pipette and pass them through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 10 mL of differentiation medium.
Add 0.5 μL of 100 μg/mL FLT3-L per 10 mL of the cell suspension (final concentration 5 ng/mL).
Prepare a new OP9/DLL1 dish by removing the medium.
Spread the cell suspension with FLT3-L onto the new OP9/DLL1 dish.
Return the dishes to the CO2 incubator.
Take up the medium from the dish with a 10-mL pipette.
Wash the surface with sufficient force not to break the OP9/DLL1 monolayer.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 50-mL conical tube through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 2 mL of reMAIT medium per 10-cm dish.
Seed 2 mL of cell suspension per well of a 6-well plate with the OP9/DLL1 monolayer.
Remove all the medium from the wells.
Add 2 mL of reMAIT medium per well.
Return the plates to the CO2 incubator.
When the round, shiny cells grow to cover the OP9/DLL1 monolayer, remove them by pipetting with sufficient force not to break the OP9/DLL1 monolayer.
Collect the cell suspension into a 15-mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 10 mL of reMAIT medium.
Seed the cell suspension onto a new 10-cm OP9/DLL1 dish.
Change half of the medium every other day or split expanded cells into additional dishes.
Remove differentiated cells (reMAIT cells) from the OP9/DLL1 monolayer by pipetting.
Replace 1 × 10^4 to 5 × 10^4 cells in a well of 96-well plate or FACS tube.
Wash the cells with FACS buffer stored at 4°C up to 3 months.
Resuspend the cells in the reaction mixture containing antibodies and MR1 tetramer for phenotyping.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C for 20 minutes.
Wash the cells with FACS buffer.
Resuspend the cells in FACS buffer containing 7-AAD (dead/live discrimination; dilution 1:200, stored at 4°C up to 6 months).
Acquire the cells with a flow cytometer.
Isolate the spleens from three euthanized 8- to 12-week-old C57BL/6 mice.
Place a 40 μm cell strainer in a 10 cm petri dish and place the spleens on the strainer.
Add 3–4 mL of cR10 and mush the spleens with a gasket portion of the plunger of a 2.5-mL syringe to strain out the cells.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 15-mL tube, rinse the petri dish with another 5 mL of cR10, and collect in a 15-mL tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 4 min and aspirate the supernatant.
Add 3 mL of 67% Percoll into a new 15-mL tube.
Suspend the cell pellet from step 12 with 8 mL of 40% Percoll.
Set the pipettor’s dispense speed to low and slowly layer the cell suspension in 40% Percoll above 3 mL of 67% Percoll with a 10-mL pipette.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 20 min at 20°C–25°C with break-off.
Collect a white layer of cells at the boundary of the two Percoll layers into a new 15-mL tube.
Fill up the tube with PBS and mix well by inverting the tube.
Centrifuge at 700 × g for 7 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant and suspend the cells in 10 mL of MACS buffer (stored at 4°C up to 3 months).
Filter the cell suspension with a 40 μm cell strainer.
Count the cells. Usually, 3–5 × 10^7 cells can be recovered from three spleens.
Adjust the cell concentration to 1 × 10^8/mL with MACS buffer.
Add 2 μL of biotin antibody cocktail per 1 × 10^7 cells.
Incubate on ice for 15 minutes.
Add 5 mL of MACS buffer and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 minutes.
Suspend the cells in MACS buffer at 1 × 10^8/mL.
Add 2 μL of streptavidin nanobeads per 1 × 10^7 cells.
Incubate on ice for 15 minutes.
Add 5 mL of MACS buffer and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 minutes.
Suspend the cells in 5 mL of MACS buffer.
Place the LS column in a magnetic separator.
Equilibrate the LS column with 3 mL of MACS buffer.
Set an empty 15-mL conical tube under the LS column to collect the cell fraction that is not attached to the magnet (negative fraction).
Apply the cell suspension from step 31 to the LS column through a 40 μm cell strainer or screen mesh and collect the fraction that passes through the LS column.
Column the fraction with 3 mL of MACS buffer and collect it in the tube.
Repeat step one more time.
Centrifuge the collected cell fraction at 400 × g for 5 min.
Suspend the cells with 3 mL of cR10.
Count the cells.
Take 1 × 10^4 cells in a 96-well plate well or a FACS tube.
Add the reaction mixture to check the purity of NK cells.
Incubate at 20–25°C for 20 min in the dark.
Wash the cells with FACS buffer.
Resuspend the cells in FACS buffer containing 7-AAD (dead/live discrimination).
Acquire the cells with a flow cytometer.
Prepare 1 × 10^6 YAC-1 cells.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Suspend the cells in pre-warmed 1 ml of 1 μM CFSE in PBS.
Incubate at 37°C for 15 min in a water bath.
Add 10 ml of cR10.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Suspend the cells in 10 ml of cR10.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min in a CO2 incubator.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Suspend the cells in 5 ml of cR10 (final cell concentration at 2 × 10^5 cells/ml).
Prepare 1.4 × 10^6 reMAIT cells.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 700 μL of cR10 at a final concentration of 2 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Make the dilution of reMAIT cells as specified.
Prepare 700 μL of NK cells at a concentration of 2 × 10^6 cells/mL in cR10 using the NK cell suspension from step 34.
Make the dilution of NK cells as specified.
Plate CFSE-labeled YAC-1 (T:Target), reMAIT cells, and NK cells (E:Effector) in triplicate in a 96-well V-bottom plate according to Table 1.
Incubate for 4 h at 37°C in a CO2 incubator.
Dilute Zombie Violet in PBS at a ratio of 1:500.
After 4 h incubation, centrifuge the 96-well plate at 500 × g for 5 min using a plate centrifuge.
Remove the supernatant by quickly inverting and flicking the plate.
Add 100 μL of diluted Zombie Violet to each well. Incubate at 20-25°C for 15 min, shielded from light.
Add 100 μL of FACS buffer to each well and centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant by quickly inverting and flicking the plate.
Scratch the bottom of the plate to loosen the cell pellets.
Add 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min.
Dump the supernatant by quickly inverting and flicking the plate.
Scratch the bottom of the plate to loosen the cell pellets.
Add 100 μL of FACS buffer.
Acquire the cells with a flow cytometer.
Analyze the flow cytometric data.
Calculate percent lysis using the provided formula.
Be sure to use 1 μM CFSE for flow cytometry analysis.
Trypsinize semi-confluent LLC and prepare a cell suspension at 1 × 10^5 cells/mL in 8% FBS/DMEM.
Spread 100 μL of the cell suspension per well into a 96-well flat-bottom culture plate (1 × 10^4 cells/well).
Incubate the LLC plates at 37°C for 16–20 hours in a CO2 incubator.
Prepare 3 × 10^6 reMAIT cells for co-culture.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL of cR10 to achieve a final concentration of 3 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Prepare 1 mL of 3 × 10^6 cells/mL NK cells in cR10 using the NK cell suspension from step 34.
Remove the medium from each well of the 96-well plate containing LLC culture.
Add appropriate amounts of reMAIT cells to a 96-well plate seeded with LLC in triplicate as shown in Table 2.
Incubate for 16–20 hours at 37°C in a CO2 incubator.
Dilute Zombie Violet in PBS at a ratio of 1:1000.
Aspirate the medium from a 96-well plate.
Wash each well with 200 μL of PBS.
Add 30 μL of the diluted Zombie Violet solution to each well.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C for 15 minutes, shielded from light.
Wash each well twice with 200 μL of PBS.
Add 30 μL of 0.25% Trypsin-1 mM EDTA to each well.
Incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Add 70 μL of 10% FBS/DMEM to each well.
Acquire the cells using a flow cytometer.
Analyze the flow cytometric data.
Calculate “percent lysis” using the provided formula.
Incubate LLC with reMAIT cells for 16-20 hours.
